messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: service=routing-proxy region=ap-southeast-1 az=az2 severity=SEV-P1 incident=P123456 - 5xx spike + connection timeouts observed. Alert rule: routing-proxy:tcp_connect_fail_rate > 0.05 for 2m

pagerduty: Incident P123456 created and assigned to: maria (oncall). Escalation policy: Red-Region-APAC. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P123456

maria (oncall): ACK. i'm on it, joining call. starting initial triage. @alex @ryan please stand by.

alex (sre): grabbing logs and checking host eviction metrics. running quick check: 
```
# listing az2 pool health
rctl pool status ap-southeast-1 az2 --json | jq '.pools[] | {id,evictions,net_err_rate}'
```
got high `net_err_rate` on pool-az2-gpu-7, evictions 42 in last 15m.

ryan (sre): seeing routing-proxy 5xx at edge gateway -> upstream timeout. tcp resets from az2 egress fabric. pulling fabric metrics now.

megan (infra): Confirming there's a partial network flap in ap-southeast-1-az2 from provider A; BGP flaps and link saturation reported. Provider support ticket INC-8942 open.

maria (oncall): impact assessment: ~12% of requests in APAC are getting 5xx; Dedicated customers in APAC reporting errors (acct: AcmeCorp, ID 888). Marking customer-impact=true. Notifying CS.

sam (cs): pinged AcmeCorp and two other customers, told them we have an ongoing APAC network event and we are failing over traffic. CS will open support incidents for any escalations.

alex (sre): initiating prioritized failover for regional routing: switching routing-proxy traffic away from az2 to az1. Command: 
```
routerctl reroute --service routing-proxy --region ap-southeast-1 --exclude-az az2 --strategy weighted --weight-az1 0.9
```
Planned: progressive 10% steps every 30s.

ops-bot: deploybot: rolling change to routing policy started by alex. Change ID: changelist/5678.

ryan (sre): can we also enable per-customer sticky fallback for Dedicated customers? we should avoid reassigning sessions mid-request.

maria (oncall): yes. applying sticky fallback for dedicated tiers now. 
```
routectl set-sticky --service routing-proxy --tier dedicated --enabled true
```

alex (sre): after first 30s step, error rate in APAC dropped from 12% -> 6%. second step to 50% in progress. monitoring kv cache warmup cost.

megan (infra): autoscaler in az1 warmed extra instances to handle new load, no OOMs. watch GPU utilization.

pagerduty: Reminder: next escalation in 5m if stability not achieved.

maria (oncall): handing over active lead to ryan for the next 25m, i have a follow-up customer sync. ryan you have the incident.

ryan (sre): ack. taking lead. continuing mitigation: full traffic shifted off az2 to az1 and az3. verifying logs.

alex (sre): host pool in az2 shows persistent network resets, provider link shows packet loss > 8%. suspect upstream edge router. we've quarantined pool-az2-gpu-7 to avoid noisy neighbors.

megan (infra): created temporary capacity in az3 to increase headroom. config id: temp-cap-apse3-2026-03.

sam (cs): CS updated customer list and sent incident bulletin: "We are actively failing over traffic from ap-southeast-1 AZ2 due to a network provider event. Most customers are routed to healthy AZs; some small request-level errors may persist. Expected full mitigation in 30-45m."

ryan (sre): monitoring shows error rate back to baseline for 90% of customers; Dedicated customers reporting recovery. marking mitigation status: partial-mitigated.

pagerduty: Incident P123456 acknowledged and mitigated. Auto-escalation cancelled.

maria (oncall): final checks: confirm az2 remains quarantined and we stop scheduling new workloads there until provider confirms fix. create postmortem ticket.

alex (sre): opened postmortem draft: PM-2026-045 ap-southeast-1 AZ2 network outage -> routing-proxy failover. adding timeline and impact buckets.

ops-bot: ticket created PM-2026-045. owner: alex (sre).

ryan (sre): adding notes: root cause suspected provider fabric instability causing TCP resets and evictions. next steps: provider follow-up, improve cross-az warming and faster auto-reroute.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident P123456 resolved (mitigated). Duration: 00:42:59. Postmortem link: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/PM-2026-045

maria (oncall): thanks team. i'll close the page after the postmortem triage. great work. :clap:
